text:
maya: Quick sync — we're planning to roll out the new pricing/packaging change next month and need a status check on metering, billing mapping, and quota enforcement. Owners please tag. TL;DR: need metering events (usage.unit, usage.tokens), billing mapping to plans, quota enforcement per-customer, contract guardrails (enterprise overrides).

jon: Eng infra: metering schema is ready (PR #432). Need billing team to confirm fields. Current ETA for merging: EOD Fri. https://redwood.internal/insights/PR/432

kyle: Billing: we'll need mapping from usage.unit -> invoice line item. Can someone paste the final plan IDs? Also need to know if token granularity is acceptable or do we aggregate per-minute. cc @suzanne

suzanne: Product: Plan IDs are prod_basic, prod_pro, prod_enterprise. Enterprise has contract clause for custom quotas (see contracts doc). We need a fallback if contract specifies 'unlimited'.

jon: On quota enforcement: eng-sre can enforce soft quotas via responses with 429 and header X-Quota-Remaining. Hard quotas require billing side to gate tokens at ingress — what's the owner for hard gating?

kyle: Billing team prefers to avoid gating at ingress; we'll do post-hoc billing and invoice adjustments. For enterprise we can set flags in tenant config to block calls. Need API to set tenant flag. Owner: me + @billing-bot to create tenant flag API.

billing-bot: billing-bot: Created issue BLG-98 for tenant flagging API. Assigned to kyle. ETA: 2024-06-07.

maya: Dependencies list for release checklist: metering PR merged, billing mapping doc approved, tenant flag API, quota headers spec, tests + e2e, prod feature flag. Can we get owners and dates?

kyle: owners: metering=jon (EOD Fri), billing mapping=me (Mon), tenant API=BLG-98 (ETA 06-07), tests=eng-qatest (need help), feature flag=maya to coordinate.

suzanne: I'll update the rollout plan and pricing page. Will sync with legal on 'unlimited' wording. Target release window week of 2024-06-10 — is that still realistic?

jon: realistic if PR merges and tests start next week. I'll ping for CRs. Quick code note: metering event fields are `event_type`, `customer_id`, `tokens`, `timestamp`, `plan_id`. Please confirm plan_id matches billing.

kyle: confirmed plan_id aligns. One ask: include `usage_tier` field for easier mapping. Can you add?

jon: will add usage_tier. pushing small commit.

maya: Awesome. Action items: jon merge PR; kyle finish mapping doc + BLG-98; suzanne update rollout + legal; maya will create release checklist in product repo. Thanks :thumbsup:

suzanne: :eyes:
